summary: Turn CSR priorities into measurable actions, sustainability KPIs and leadership reporting. Explore the five-day course outline.
lede: Corporate sustainability training helps sustainability coordinators, CSR leads and operations managers turn priority impacts into owned operating actions. Learners practise mapping material issues, recording emissions and resource baselines, screening supplier risks, and setting KPIs with accountable owners. They also develop a sustainability roadmap and concise progress brief using the GRI Standards and the GHG Protocol, with introductory coverage of related frameworks and life-cycle thinking.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who translate sustainability commitments into operating choices, measurable actions and reporting. It suits foundation-level learners who work with environmental, social or CSR responsibilities and need practical tools for coordinating across functions.
modules: Sustainable Business Leadership and UN SDGs
prerequisites: Suitable for foundation-level professionals with a working familiarity with their organization’s business activities. No prior sustainability reporting or emissions-accounting experience is required; basic spreadsheet use is helpful.
